heroBody: The LG C5 OLED is one of the safest premium TV buys in Singapore in 2026 because it sits in the sweet spot between entry OLED and flagship gallery models: excellent black levels, mature webOS apps, HDMI 2.1 for consoles and enough brightness for most HDB and condo living rooms. In Singapore, LG C5 pricing moves sharply by screen size and seller type. Authorised retailers such as Harvey Norman, Courts and Challenger usually hold close to list price but include local warranty and delivery options, while Shopee Mall, LazMall and Amazon.sg can undercut during platform sale windows. This page pulls live Singapore listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so you can see which LG C5 size is actually cheapest in S$ right now.

highlightSectionTitle: What matters on the LG C5 OLED in 2026

highlights.title: The C-series is still the mainstream OLED benchmark
highlights.body: The LG C5 keeps the C-series formula that has made it the default OLED recommendation for years: a strong processor, full HDMI 2.1 support, low input lag and a panel that looks excellent with streaming video. It is not the brightest OLED LG sells, but it is the one most Singapore buyers should compare first because the price gap to the flagship G-series is rarely worth it in a normal living room.

highlights.title: Screen size drives the real deal
highlights.body: The cheapest LG C5 listing is not always the best value. A 55-inch set may have the lowest absolute price, but the 65-inch and 77-inch sizes often receive larger platform discounts because retailers stock more of them for living rooms. If your sofa is about 2.5 to 3.5 metres away, a 65-inch C5 is usually the value sweet spot.

highlights.title: Local warranty is worth checking twice
highlights.body: OLED panels are reliable, but they are expensive to service. A parallel-import LG C5 can look tempting when the sticker price is lower, yet the saving disappears if the listing only carries shop warranty. For a big-ticket TV in Singapore, a clear LG Singapore warranty is usually worth paying a modest premium for.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pay the least without buying the wrong set
advicePoints: Choose the screen size before comparing prices. The 55-inch C5 suits bedrooms and compact living rooms, the 65-inch is right for most HDB living rooms, and the 77-inch only makes sense when you sit far enough back.
Look for the exact model family and year in the listing title. Older LG C-series stock can sit beside new C5 listings, and a discounted C4 may be a good buy only if the price gap is meaningful.
Verify warranty wording before checkout. 'Local set', 'LG Singapore warranty' or an official store badge is materially different from a shop warranty on a parallel import.
Time the buy around 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and the IT Show / PC Show periods. Singapore TV discounts usually follow platform calendars rather than LG announcements.
Do not pay extra for a bundle unless you need the soundbar or wall mount. Retailers use bundles to hide the TV's true discount; compare the panel-only price first.
If your room is very bright all day, compare against Mini-LED sets before buying. The C5 is bright for OLED, but a premium Mini-LED can still be easier to watch in direct sunlight.
faqSectionTitle: LG C5 OLED in Singapore — common questions

faqs.question: What size LG C5 OLED should I buy in Singapore?
faqs.answer: For most Singapore homes, the 65-inch LG C5 is the best balance of price and immersion. A 55-inch set works for bedrooms or compact living rooms, while 77-inch makes sense only if your viewing distance is around 2.5 metres or more and the console or wall mount can handle it.

faqs.question: Is a parallel-import LG C5 OLED worth it?
faqs.answer: Only if the discount is large and you are comfortable with shop warranty. For an OLED TV, panel service can be expensive, so a local LG Singapore warranty from an authorised retailer or official marketplace store is usually the safer buy.

faqs.question: When is the LG C5 cheapest in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Historically during Shopee and Lazada sale days such as 9.9, 10.10, 11.11 and 12.12, plus local electronics show periods. Outside those windows, the live listings on this page show the current floor across Singapore retailers.

faqs.question: Should I buy the LG C5 or wait for the LG C6?
faqs.answer: If your current TV is failing or the live C5 price is well below list, buy the C5. Year-to-year OLED changes are incremental for most streaming and console use, and the larger saving usually matters more than waiting for a brighter successor.

categoryIntro.heading: Why Singapore LG C5 OLED prices swing by retailer
categoryIntro.body: Singapore TV pricing is unusually promotion-driven. The same LG C5 OLED can appear at one price in a Harvey Norman showroom, another on an official LazMall store, another on Shopee Mall with platform vouchers, and a lower-but-riskier price from a parallel importer. Delivery, installation, disposal of the old set and warranty coverage also vary by seller, which means the cheapest sticker price is not always the lowest total cost. This page keeps the comparison focused on live Singapore listings so you can decide whether the current discount is worth taking or whether waiting for the next platform sale is smarter.
